standard.title: Fitness and health participation
standard.description: participate in physical activities designed to improve fitness and wellbeing to investigate the impact of regular participation on health, fitness and wellbeing
standard.prior_knowledge: Students have participated in physical activities and investigated the body's reaction to different levels of intensity (Y5-6). They can describe physical changes during exercise but have not yet systematically investigated the relationship between regular participation and health outcomes.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students participate in physical activities designed to improve fitness and wellbeing and investigate the impact of regular participation on health, fitness and wellbeing.

nodes.label: Understanding fitness components and wellbeing dimensions
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can identify the main fitness components (e.g. cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength, flexibility) and wellbeing dimensions and explain what types of physical activities target each.
nodes.minimum_width: Identify at least two fitness components or wellbeing dimensions and describe one activity type that targets each.
nodes.typical_width: Identify the range of fitness components and wellbeing dimensions (physical, social, emotional, mental); explain which activity types address which components; connect these to the elaboration contexts (circuit training, yoga, mindfulness, HIIT).
wider: Research unfamiliar activity forms (yoga, mindfulness meditation, gym classes, HIIT) and compare how each targets different components and dimensions of health and wellbeing
Investigate how different cultures define and pursue health and wellbeing through physical practice, examining examples relevant to the class community
nodes.hinge_reason: The investigation requirement in the descriptor depends on students having a conceptual framework for what aspects of health and fitness can vary. Without this, participation becomes physically purposeful but analytically empty — students cannot investigate impact without knowing what to measure.

response_modes.reason: Build a shared framework for fitness components and wellbeing dimensions before launching investigation. Use it as an analytical lens that students apply consistently across different activity types.

success_criteria: Names at least two fitness components or wellbeing dimensions
Identifies at least one activity type designed to improve each named component or dimension

nodes.label: Participating with investigative intent
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can participate in physical activities designed to improve fitness or wellbeing while noticing and recording specific evidence of impact on their health, fitness or wellbeing.
nodes.minimum_width: Participate in one physical activity and record at least one piece of evidence about its impact on health, fitness or wellbeing.
nodes.typical_width: Participate in activities targeting different fitness components and wellbeing dimensions; collect evidence of impact using observation, self-report or digital tools; compare effects across different activity types or durations.
wider: Use digital tools to track participation data over multiple sessions and identify patterns in health, fitness or wellbeing indicators
Design and perform a fitness circuit that could be implemented at home with minimal equipment and monitor its impact on at least one fitness component over time

response_modes.reason: Investigative participation requires repeated practice — a single session of noticing and recording does not establish the pattern recognition that 'regular participation' implies. Students need multiple cycles of participation plus evidence collection.

success_criteria: Participates in a physical activity designed to improve fitness or wellbeing
Records at least one specific piece of evidence of impact on their health, fitness or wellbeing

nodes.label: Investigating the impact of regular participation
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can investigate the relationship between regular physical activity participation and outcomes for health, fitness and wellbeing, drawing on their participation data and research evidence.
nodes.minimum_width: Describe at least one finding from their own participation or from a research source about the impact of regular physical activity on health, fitness or wellbeing.
nodes.typical_width: Investigate the impact of regular participation using a combination of personal participation data and external sources; compare effects on different health and wellbeing outcomes; design a personal activity program responsive to individual goals and the investigation findings.
wider: Design and monitor a personal physical activity program using digital tools, evaluating its effectiveness against individual health, wellbeing and fitness goals over multiple weeks
Research how access to fitness and wellbeing activities differs across community contexts and examine the implications for health equity

response_modes.reason: Investigation integrates participation experience with research evidence and personal data analysis. Instruction should support students in drawing these together rather than treating participation and investigation as separate tasks.

success_criteria: States at least one finding about the impact of regular participation on health, fitness or wellbeing
Connects the finding to either personal participation evidence or an external source
Links the finding to a design decision in a personal or class activity program
